Class GameControllerGUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.GameControllerGUI
public class GameControllerGUI extends Object
Main controller for the game scene. Orchestrates all sub-controllers for the board, rows, offer tiles, turn order, deck and player boards. Binds the ObservableGameModel to the UI so all components update automatically when the server sends new data. Also manages the action label and player turn feedback.

  • Method Details

    • setController

      public void setController(ClientController clientController, SceneManager sceneManager, ObservableGameModel model, String nickname)
      Injects all dependencies and initializes the board, player panels and model bindings. Schedules an initial UI refresh to ensure all nodes are rendered before interactivity is enabled.
      Parameters:
      clientController - the client controller used to send game actions
      sceneManager - the scene manager used for scene transitions
      model - the observable game model to bind to
      nickname - the local player's nickname

    • initBoard

      private void initBoard()
      Loads and assembles all subcomponents of the central game board. Creates the top row, deck, turn order track, offer tiles, bottom row, info labels and action label, and arranges them in the center VBox.

    • initPlayerBoard

      private void initPlayerBoard()
      Creates and places a player board panel for each player. The local player is placed at the bottom without rotation. Other players are assigned to slots based on total player count, and rotated or scaled to fit their position around the board.

    • bindModel

      private void bindModel()
      Registers listeners on all observable properties and lists of the game model. Each listener triggers either a direct update on the relevant sub-controller or a scheduled UI refresh via scheduledRefresh. Also performs the initial population of all board components.

    • scheduledRefresh

      public void scheduledRefresh()
      Schedules a single UI refresh via Platform.runLater. Uses a flag to ensure that multiple rapid model changes result in only one refresh call.

    • refreshUI

      private void refreshUI()
      Refreshes all interactive and informational UI components. Checks if the game has ended, updates row and offer tile interactivity, updates the era and round labels, the action label and the skip button. The skip button is updated only for the main player and only if it is currently their turn during an extra draw phase.

    • updateActionLabel

      public void updateActionLabel(GameState state)
      Updates the action label text and color based on the current game state. If the label is locked by a temporary message, does nothing. Shows whose turn it is and what action is expected.
      Parameters:
      state - the current game state

    • setActionMessage

      public void setActionMessage(String message, boolean accept)
      Displays a temporary action result message on the action label. Locks the label for a short duration so the message remains visible. Accepted actions are shown for 1 second, rejected actions for 3 seconds. After the timer expires, the label returns to showing the current game state.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to display
      accept - true if the action was accepted, false if rejected

    • showMessage

      public void showMessage(String message)
      Displays a generic message on the action label in orange. Used for non-critical notifications that do not lock the label.
      Parameters:
      message - the message to display
